scope: Real OSV offline scans, unchanged-constraint uv resolution with complete pinned Git source metadata, candidate rescans and derived-verdict-free MCP inputs. uv metadata backend environments/hooks may run; no project environment installed, no neural calls.
target_policy: Direct declaration first, descending scanner advisory-group count, lexicographic key; fixed before vulnerability results.
database_policy: Download official PyPI all.zip once, record exact full-byte SHA256 and object generation before any scan. Both baseline and candidate use --offline and the same unmodified database.
new_regression: Known editable roots with recorded or absent versions are separate from registry dependencies. Empty scanner version matches only an absent local-source version; unknown package entries remain rejected. Same expanded root test errors on v2/pass on candidate.
scan_repetition_reason: Actual integration parser failure fixed; replay offline scans on unchanged frozen database and source lock inputs. No model calls, rescoring or independent result-count aggregation.
input_revision_note: Same two project commits/metadata bytes and same frozen DB/scanner. Corrected incomplete project metadata preparation and initial overbroad no-install wording; older failed/partial reports remain preserved.
